verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents an `agent` primitive that turns high-level tasks into fully autonomous browser workflows, with configurable models, instructions and max steps. Supporting features include remote Browserbase browsers, session replay, persistent contexts, self-heal and auto-caching into deterministic scripts. However, nothing shows that users can schedule, trigger or leave automations running unattended in the background; Stagehand appears to be an SDK the user must invoke and host themselves. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/triggers or background job execution, a managed unattended run environment documented as part of Stagehand, independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.
